diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.default must wait for :resource.aws_s3_bucket.origin when managing a newly created origin bucket; otherwise PutBucketPolicy can run before the bucket exists. The supplied graph contains no ordering path between them.
:resource.aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.origin must wait for :resource.aws_s3_bucket.origin to exist before configuring its public access block; the supplied graph contains no such dependency.

:data.aws_s3_bucket.selected reads the managed origin bucket and must wait for :resource.aws_s3_bucket.origin to exist. Without an ordering path in the supplied graph, the lookup can run before bucket creation.
